checker.scope: constant algebra and exact endpoint integral identities only

premises_preserved: independence is used only in original physical coordinate blocks
for an independent-copy coordinate pair U=X+X', V=X-X', the exact joint density is retained and U,V are not declared independent
no law-uniform pointwise quadratic-phase decay is used
no conditional cap after sum/difference conditioning is used
the square shift h(W) may be arbitrarily correlated with residual R(W)
continuity is separate from essential boundedness
new_results: Fractional pair-collision criterion: for Q=d(Z+h(W))^2+R(W), if S_alpha=int |eta_R|^(2alpha)<infinity for 1/2<=alpha<1, then ||p_Q||inf <= 2/[sqrt(pi(1-alpha))] |d|^-1/2 S_alpha^1/2.
At alpha=3/4, the bound is 4/sqrt(pi) times the square root of int psi^(3/4); residual L3 gives 4sqrt(2)|d|^-1/2||p_R||_3^(3/4).
Dyadic pair-collision shell criterion: ||p_Q||inf <= |d|^-1/2[2sqrt(2/pi)sqrt(tau)+pi^-1/2 sum_k sqrt(E_k(tau))].
Endpoint obstruction: an explicit cap-one X has X^2 density in L2 but Q=Z^2-X^2 unbounded; therefore finite total pair-collision energy int psi is insufficient.
Applying account04/B01 signed Fejer theorem yields an explicit linear interval bound from the fractional collision criterion.
unresolved: From only three eigenvalues of modulus at least one, force a product-preserving completed branch or a physical pivot with dimension-free S_alpha for some fixed alpha<1.
Handle the singleton-plus-two-banks and local-cross-rank-three families without reducing to a fixed local minor/cut.
Continuity is not proved by the new fractional/dyadic criterion.
next_mechanism: Attack a structural averaged-pivot inequality for fractional pair-collision cost rather than one fixed pivot/minor: seek a weighted sum over physical pivots whose total cost is controlled by spectral mass and which is stable on the singleton-plus-two-banks family.
